text:
Jordan: quick docket/blip on the gateway auth + rate work — short updates, blockers, and a couple small asks.

Jordan: canary for gw-v2 finished in staging, basic traffic looks good. seeing one intermittent 401 on /v1/generate tied to JWT kid rotation.

Priya: curious — is that a signing key timing issue or cache TTL?

Jordan: looks like cache TTL on jwks fetches — some pods were still using older keys during rotation. env var `JWKS_CACHE_TTL` was unset in the new deployment so defaulted to 0.

Alex: I opened PR #4123 to set a sane default (5m) and added a small backoff on JWKS fetch failures. can someone review? @Priya @Taylor

Priya: on my list, will review in ~30m.

Taylor: one more thing — internal health probes are causing short bursts that trip rate limits for a subset of routes. propose an opt-out rule for infra checks using a header `X-Infra-Check: true` so probes don't burn tokens.

Jordan: agreed. draft rule in the policy repo (snippet below). open to comments.

Jordan: ```
- match: header('X-Infra-Check') == 'true'
  action: bypass_rate_limit
  note: internal probes only
```

Nadia: slightly worried about header spoofing from external clients. can we gate that with source IP whitelist + short TTL?

Taylor: good call — add an IP range check and keep a conservative limit. e.g. allow bypass only for 10.0.0.0/24 and fallback to 100r/min for others.

Jordan: will update the rule: add `source_ip` check and set fallback to 100r/min, escalate to unlimited only if IP in infra ranges.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: gw-v2 -> 3/3 pods ready. No 5xx in last 10m :tada:

Alex: blockers from my side: need auth example in the SDK docs updated (token rotation snippet + recommended cache settings). I'll file a docs ticket after PR lands.

Priya: from auth team — no further blockers once PR merged and JWKS TTL patched. recommend we monitor error-rate for next 6 hours.

Jordan: rollback plan tested locally. I'll pair with @Taylor for the production rollout at 14:00 PST in case we need to revert quickly.

Taylor: :thumbsup:

Jordan: OK closing this docket. If anything breaks, ping #eng-oncall or DM me. Thanks all.
